SeongHyun Kristine Seo

Researcher at LG Energy Solution · Forecasting & Decision-Making under Uncertainty

I'm SeongHyun Kristine Seo, a researcher at LG Energy Solution working on diagnostic algorithms for EV battery fleets. My research interest is forecasting and decision-making under uncertainty in real-world industrial systems: how to forecast the state of complex systems, how far to trust those forecasts, and how to turn them into decisions when failure labels are scarce and arrive late.

Research interests:
  • Uncertainty-aware time-series forecasting
  • Learning with scarce and delayed labels
  • Decision-making under uncertainty
  • Application domains: manufacturing, aerospace, and battery systems (prognostics and health management)

INDUSTRY

Early Warning Reporting for Aircraft Manufacturing

Built an early-warning system that forecasts quality risks in aircraft manufacturing and traces their root causes with causal discovery, delivered through an automated reporting pipeline.

Aug 2025 – Mar 2026
INDUSTRY

Predictive Modeling for Productivity Enhancement

Built ensemble models (Huber regression, XGBoost, Extra Trees) for five productivity targets in steel manufacturing, reaching an accuracy of 84.7 against a project KPI of 80.8.

Summer 2024
INDUSTRY

AI Modeling for BPED Process in LiOH Production

Modeled POSCO's BPED process for lithium hydroxide production with time-series models and built real-time anomaly detection, leading the project as data scientist and PM.
